checks.detail: frontend-source/index.html is design-only and explicitly forbidden from public/index.html
app.js, settings.js, api.js are extend-in-place; value-select.js is reused unchanged
prototype/index.html mirrors the current public document and renders the actual local production CSS/components/UI behavior; it has no production transfer mapping
entrypoint renders all four nonempty zones over file:// without HTML partial fetches or a local HTTP server
prototype/mock-fetch.js owns data/provider responses only; the browser run records zero HTTP(S), CORS, console or page errors
[data-pane-host] is immutable and can be updated only through existing Plotly/slider paths
settings tabs, content, footer and unified Apply selectors exist in public/index.html
inspector tabs/body/rows and current row-action renderer seams exist
existing x/y slider menuitemcheckbox controls are reused
only [data-main-signal=true].is-main-signal receives persistent blue; all other rows remain white with grey hover independent of checked visibility
plain LMB row click toggles its checkbox membership and selects the checked row as main_signal; unchecking current main falls back to the first remaining checked signal
Основное and Сводка use the existing settings-group title/body disclosure contract and Дискретизация, Гц label
pane click selects Область settings; display-tab click and display creation select Экран settings without changing shell geometry
pane-menu and Area settings checkbox projections share one active-pane draft
operation dialog is an on-demand document.body singleton and reuses the existing value-select popup
projected spectrum extrema and cursor-based sample pages are public/js/api.js -> public/js/app.js seams
v30 screenshots are regenerated from the actual current production DOM/CSS/components/UI behavior and the standalone interaction walkthrough passes 23/23
